Build the error message for a context var_in that names no column

Source: R/utils.R
util_context_var_in_message.Rd

Reports the dataset, each affected context_property, and the column name that is missing – the three things the raw tidyselect failure did not name (#247). Where a close match exists among the available columns it is suggested, since the usual cause is a typo.

util_context_var_in_message(
  contexts,
  missing_var_in,
  data_columns,
  traits_fields = character()
)

Arguments

contexts

Contexts tibble, as returned by process_format_contexts()

missing_var_in

Character vector of var_in values not found

data_columns

Character vector of columns in the data, after custom_R_code has run

traits_fields

Character vector of fields declared on the traits entries of metadata.yml, the other place a var_in may be satisfied

Value

A length-1 character string
